text: Here's how to get started with ByggExp. The first time you open the app, the home screen shows four steps.
First, choose your project – and the first step is checked off.
Next, report your time. With GPS, time is counted automatically while you're on site. You can also enter hours directly – or use Arbetspass.
Let's choose Arbetspass.
The app briefly shows how it works.
Tap Öppna Arbetspass.
Under Manuell, tap Lägg till timmar.
Enter your working hours, here eight, and confirm with the check mark.
Add overtime with plus – here two hours.
OB – pay for inconvenient working hours – works the same way.
Under Resa, enter your travel time and how many kilometres you drove.
Further down are allowance, absence, photos, receipts and a comment. The total: eleven hours, including two hours of overtime.
The week shows your hours day by day. Fill in the rest of the week the same way.
Two of four done. The next step is your profile.
Enter your name – your email is already there.
Fill in your trade, for example concrete worker.
You can also add a phone number and documents, for example certificates. Change your profile photo with the pen.
Tap the check mark to save – your profile is updated.
Three of four done. Last step: customise the home screen.
First, pick a theme you like.
Under Visa, you decide what is shown: project, clock and round buttons.
Under Knappar, turn shortcuts on and off with one tap.
Done – the home screen shows only what you need. Now you're ready to report your time.
